display.purpose: Page greetings, hero titles, project/session titles, panel headlines.

body.purpose: Descriptions, notes, form hints, default running text.

label.purpose: Section headers, field labels, badges/chips, filter tabs — the system's connective tissue.

mark.purpose: Sidebar brand wordmark only. Never used for body headings or buttons.

shadows.name: card-inset-sheen
shadows.purpose: Simulated top-edge light catch on the login card; not a real shadow.

shadows.name: entrance-pool
shadows.purpose: Deep, soft shadow under the login card on mount.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Stat cards on hover, paired with a 3px translateY lift.

shadows.name: sticky-bar-separation
shadows.purpose: Top bar separating from scrolling content beneath it.

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Hover color/border transitions on buttons, links, inputs.

motion.name: standard
motion.purpose: Sidebar drawer slide, top-bar hide/show, ink-sweep button hover.

motion.name: entrance
motion.purpose: Card and section entrance animations (opacity + translateY).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled steel-on-ink action button; glass-round 8px radius (st-btn, canonical for new work).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 18px; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #07080a; background: #e7eef2; border: 1px solid #e7eef2; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.18s ease, background 0.18s ease, border-color 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ffffff; border-color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(195,210,219,0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined/ghost action button used for lower-emphasis actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 18px; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #aab6bf; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #23272e; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { color: #e7eef2; border-color: #707b86; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(195,210,219,0.3); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Fully-rounded status pill; hue swaps by status family (info/success/warning/danger).
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 3px 9px; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid transparent; } .ds-badge--info { color: #d6e4ee; border-color: rgba(120,160,190,0.45); background: rgba(120,160,190,0.14); } .ds-badge--success { color: #d9efe0; border-color: rgba(84,196,138,0.4); background: rgba(84,196,138,0.16); } .ds-badge--warning { color: #f0e2c8; border-color: rgba(200,150,55,0.45); background: rgba(148,111,42,0.22); } .ds-badge--danger { color: #f2d6d2; border-color: rgba(192,57,47,0.5); background: rgba(192,57,47,0.18); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Sunken-surface text field with an eyebrow label above it (agenda variant, 8px radius).
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field__label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #707b86; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 10px 12px; font: inherit; font-size: 14px; color: #e7eef2; background: #15181d; border: 1px solid #23272e; border-radius: 8px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #4a525b; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #707b86; } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: #c2685f; }

components.name: Glass Panel
components.description: Resting-elevation surface: translucent ink + blur + faint top-edge highlight, no shadow at rest.
components.html:
Próximas citas

Sin citas para hoy.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #23272e; border-radius: 16px; background: radial-gradient(130% 100% at 100% 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.07), transparent 58%), rgba(14,16,19,0.74); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); } .ds-panel__title { margin: 0 0 8px; font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: #e7eef2; } .ds-panel__body { margin: 0; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; color: #707b86; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar navigation row; active state adds a vermillion inset edge — the only navigational use of the accent.
components.css: .ds-navitem { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; width: 100%; padding: 11px 13px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #707b86; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.18s ease, background 0.18s ease; } .ds-navitem:hover { color: #c3d2db; background: rgba(195,210,219,0.05); } .ds-navitem--active { color: #e7eef2; background: rgba(195,210,219,0.07); box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 #c0392f; } .ds-navitem:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(195,210,219,0.3); }

narrative.overview: This name and its light-mode counterpart, "Washi," already exist verbatim in the project's own CSS comments — this design system makes that incumbent identity explicit rather than inventing a new one. The system reads as a tattoo studio's stencil-and-ink workshop translated into a dark, glass-paneled app: deep near-black ink canvases, cool steel-gray text, hairline borders, and exactly one warm color — a vermillion red the codebase's own comments call "the red of irezumi" — used with real restraint. Corners split into two deliberate dialects: flat 3px edges on stencil-like elements and soft 8-18px "glass" rounding on the app-shell surfaces that hold content. A gothic blackletter mark (Pirata One) is reserved for the sidebar wordmark only. Light mode ("Washi", rice paper) is described in the source as "the reverse of the irezumi" — the same structure rebuilt on warm paper tones with ink-dark text, keeping vermillion as the one constant between both modes.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first, near-black ink canvas with a warm-paper Washi light mode that mirrors the same structure.
Exactly one accent hue (vermillion), spent sparingly, never as a UI-wide primary.
Glass panels carry elevation instead of drop shadows; shadows are reserved for hover lifts and floating layers.
Two coexisting corner languages: stencil-flat (3px) vs. glass-round (8-18px), plus full-pill badges/chips.
An uppercase, heavily letter-spaced eyebrow label treatment is the connective tissue across every view.
Literal stencil-alignment corner marks decorate key cards as a signature motif.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Vermillion is spent on fewer than a handful of small elements per screen. If a new component wants a second saturated color, route it through the status palette or drop the color.

rules.name: The Danger-Is-Not-Vermillion Rule
rules.body: --danger (a muted rose) and the vermillion accent are deliberately different reds: danger means a form error, vermillion means the brand. Don't reach for one when you mean the other.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Every section, panel, and form group is preceded by an uppercase, heavily tracked micro-label in --ash. Never skip it to save vertical space.

rules.name: The Mark-Is-Sacred Rule
rules.body: Pirata One appears in exactly one place: the sidebar wordmark. Do not use it for body headings, buttons, or emphasis.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat (glass) at rest. A shadow only appears as a response to hover, entrance, or a floating/modal layer.

rules.name: The Stencil Marks Rule
rules.body: Corner registration marks are reserved for the most 'arrival' moment in the app (login). Don't scatter them onto every card.

dos: Do keep vermillion to small marks — never a fill for a large surface.
Do precede every section/group with an uppercase, tracked eyebrow label in --ash.
Do use glass panels for resting elevation; reserve real shadows for hover/entrance/modal motion.
Do make every badge/chip/pill fully rounded (999px) — no exception exists in the current system.
Do keep light mode ("Washi") token-driven via the page-scoped [data-theme="light"] .page-class pattern.
Do show not-yet-built nav items as visible-but-disabled (0.45 opacity) rather than hiding them.
donts: Don't use the Pirata One mark font anywhere but the sidebar wordmark.
Don't confuse --danger (muted rose, form errors only) with the vermillion --accent (brand/status only).
Don't add a third button system alongside .btn and .st-btn; consolidate toward .st-btn's glass-round 8px radius.
Don't scatter the stencil corner-marks motif onto ordinary cards — it's reserved for arrival moments like login.
Don't extend the hardcoded "Hector Tattoos" / "by Héctor" wordmark text into new surfaces — it's placeholder demo branding, not a confirmed product name.
